text:
You were afraid of my mortal flesh, and in it you sought

the immortal soul. To find it, with harsh words

you opened great wounds in me.

Then you bent over them and breathed in,

terrible, the scent of my blood.

translation.title: You Were Afraid of My Mortal Flesh
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the clinical violence of a spiritual search enacted upon the woman's body.
